# Setting up the environment for an OpenShift Container Platform installation on {{ ibm_cloud_bm }} {#install-ibm-cloud-installation-workflow}

After you complete the prerequisites, set up the environment for an OpenShift Container Platform installation on {{ ibm_cloud_bm }} by preparing the provisioner node, configuring the network, and deploying the cluster.
